tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search the open tech jobs on Jobs Every Hour: every job is read from the employer's own careers page and re-checked every hour. Words are matched in the title, company, skills, place and text of each posting, best match first. Add 'remote' for remote jobs only.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: The full posting of one job: the employer's own text, place, pay, when it was posted, when it was last seen open, and the link to apply on the employer's site.
